name: Unitika Ltd.
blurb: Unitika Ltd. (TSE: 3103) is a Japanese industrial materials company founded in 1889 and headquartered in Osaka. Its business spans three segments: polymer resins (engineering plastics), functional materials (including glass fibres and activated carbon), and textiles. Within the semiconductor supply chain, Unitika is significant as one of a small number of manufacturers of E-glass yarn — the borosilicate glass fibre woven into the laminate substrates used in printed circuit boards and ABF packaging. Because semiconductor-grade E-glass requires tight compositional and dimensional tolerances, the qualified supplier base is narrow, giving Unitika structural pricing power when substrate demand surges.
recent: Unitika's stock reached an all-time high of ¥3,085 in April 2026, having traded as low as ¥124 in April 2025 — a roughly 25-fold move in twelve months. Supply-chain analysts following the AI hardware build-out have flagged Unitika's E-glass business as a sleeper beneficiary of ABF substrate capacity expansions at Ibiden and Unimicron. The stock entered the @zephyr_z9 watchlist at ¥1,327 and was tracked to ¥2,835 over the report period.
